name: Ambient Limiter
description: A true-peak ceiling for the master that turns a sustained swell down smoothly first, so a drone leaning on it stays clean and one loud moment is soon over.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. A slow feed-forward gain stage (peak-hold detector, 250 ms down, Release up) in front of the library's own true-peak brickwall, livemix::TruePeakLimiter (cpp/devices/true-peak-limiter/true_peak_limiter.h), prepared with a fixed 72-frame lookahead so the latency is 77 samples at every sample rate. Not a model of any unit.
